name: Maubin

queries.query: Maubin Myanmar cadastral parcel map land registry official; Maubin land records SLRD GIS public viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Myanmar's Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD) as the national land-records and cadastral mapping agency, its public English site and stated mapping/land-record functions, and the Department of Population's official Maubin Township report. No official public Maubin parcel viewer, downloadable parcel layer, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry service was found.

queries.result: Burmese-language discovery found official SLRD material describing township land-record map-copy and survey procedures, and an official government Maubin Land Marks notice. These establish general public land-record procedures and local place context, but do not expose a Maubin parcel viewer, parcel schema, native parcel IDs, or safe parcel geometry.
